title: Head of Membership Growth
description:
SmarterHome.ai

Reports To

President

Location Remote — Latin America or India, with at least 4 hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific Time.

Travel

Periodic trips to our Newport Beach, California headquarters; a valid U.S. visa for business travel is required or must be obtainable.

Type

Full-time

About Us

SmarterHome.ai is a membership platform that helps U.S. households save money and manage their home, with real-time help from Hey Smarty, our AI concierge.

The Role

You grow our membership: more households joining, staying, and getting value every month. You own the number, the budget, and a dedicated development team. This is a hands-on role for a growth operator, not a strategy or coordination role.

What You'll Do

* Run lifecycle marketing across SMS, email, push, and in-app: onboarding, conversion, renewal, and win-back
* Design offers, pricing tests, and promotions, and run weekly experiments with measured results
* Own the member growth budget and put money where it performs
* Direct developers on the member experience across web and mobile
* Turn member data into decisions, and hold partners to the data quality we need
* Report directly to the President with a weekly written update

How You'll Be Measured

Growth in active members, retention, conversion, and the return on every dollar you spend.

To Apply

Along with your resume, answer one question: walk us through a lifecycle program you ran — the budget, the control group, the lift, and what you cut.

 **Requirements**

Must-Have Skills

* 6+ years in growth, lifecycle, or retention marketing for a U.S. consumer subscription, membership, or loyalty business
* A track record of measurable lift in conversion or retention, with the numbers to prove it
* Hands-on with a lifecycle platform (Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, Customer.io, or similar) and SMS at scale
* Working knowledge of U.S. SMS consent and compliance rules (TCPA)
* Has owned a marketing budget and can show the return on it
* Has directed developers or acted as a product owner
* Strong analytical skills and highly fluent with AI tools in everyday work
* Excellent written English

Nice to Have

* Rewards, cashback, card-linked offers, or member discount programs
* Home services, telecom, insurance, or fintech
* AI-powered product features
* Spanish fluency

 **Benefits**

Compensation will be discussed throughout the hiring process and will be aligned with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.

### **About Nikah Forever**

Nikah Forever is India’s leading community matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages convenient and meaningful for the Muslim community. With **over 5 Million+ members**, we are redefining how people connect and build lifelong relationships through trust, technology, and cultural understanding.

Our mission is to simplify the marriage journey while fostering genuine connections rooted in shared values and traditions.

### **About this job**

We’re looking for a SDET with strong coding fundamentals, practical AI skills, and a creative problem-solving mindset. You should enjoy exploring how systems work, finding unexpected ways they can fail, and writing code to test them. Your work will go beyond the UI—covering mobile, web, APIs, backend services, databases, and third-party integrations.

We value a mindsets like : question assumptions, investigate unusual behaviour, think beyond predefined test cases, and turn repetitive work into automation. Freshers with strong projects, internships, or demonstrated practical skills are welcome. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams, taking increasing ownership as you learn the platform.

### **Responsibility**

**Test Automation & Engineering** - Build and maintain automated tests for critical web, mobile, and API workflows. - Write reusable test utilities, assertions, and scripts using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java. - Use frameworks such as Playwright, Appium, Selenium, or equivalent tools, depending on the application. - Create reliable test data and investigate failing or flaky tests. - Contribute to running automated tests through CI/CD pipelines.

**Functional & Exploratory Testing** - Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, boundary, negative, and end-to-end testing. - Validate journeys across onboarding, profiles, search, chat, notifications, subscriptions, and payments. - Think beyond the happy path: test interrupted journeys, repeated actions, unexpected inputs, and changing network conditions. - Verify features against requirements and help identify missing acceptance criteria.

**API, Backend & Database Validation**

* Test APIs using Postman and code-based automated tests.
* Validate payloads, status codes, authentication, business rules, and error handling.
* Use SQL to verify records, state transitions, and consistency across UI, API, and database.
Read application/server logs and trace issues across UI API backend* database.
* Validate integrations with payment gateways, OTP/SMS/WhatsApp services, and notifications.

**Mobile & Payment Flows** - Test Android and iOS apps, including applications built with Flutter. - Validate permissions, deep links, push notifications, app lifecycle, and network-related behaviour. - Test checkout, subscriptions, trials, offers, and payment success, failure, cancellation, retry, and timeout scenarios. - Check that transaction states remain consistent across the application and backend.

**AI-Assisted Testing & Problem Solving** - Use AI coding assistants and LLMs to support test design, automation, debugging, and defect investigation. - Provide relevant requirements, code, logs, and API details to get useful AI output. - Review and validate generated code and test cases for correctness, coverage, and maintainability. - Build small scripts or tools that improve testing speed and reduce repetitive effort. - Exercise judgment when sharing application data with AI tools.

**Defect Investigation & Release Quality** - Write clear bug reports with reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, and supporting evidence. - Work with developers to isolate issues and contribute to root cause analysis. - Verify fixes, run regression checks, and support release smoke testing and post-release validation.

### **Qualification**

* 0–1 year of experience in testing, development, or automation; relevant projects and internships count.
* Projects involving mobile automation, Flutter testing, or API test suites.
* Familiarity with Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools.
* Exposure to payment gateways, webhooks, or third-party integrations.
* Basic understanding of performance testing, concurrency, and security testing.
* Personal tools, GitHub contributions, or examples of bugs you discovered independently.

title: Staff Mobile Engineer (Engineer, Mobile - 5)
description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India's Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The **Search & Referrals team** owns Tide's marketing website and leads the expansion of our referral programme. We are responsible for designing growth loops, scaling user acquisition initiatives, and building product experiences that contribute to Tide's growth. You will work closely with the team to deliver impactful solutions across Tide's marketing and referral experiences.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a **Staff Mobile Engineer** at Tide you will be working on the designing, creating and running the rich product catalogue in one of our **Business** **areas,** working across multiple teams. We have a long roadmap ahead of us and rarely run out of interesting problems to tackle.

This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference by taking ownership of engineering practices in a rapidly expanding company! We trust and empower our engineers to **make real technical decisions** **that affect multiple teams** and shape the future of Tide's Global **One Platform**.

We work in small autonomous teams, grouped under common domains owning the micro-frontends that makes Tide a great application. We self-organise, gather together to discuss technical challenges, and set our own guidelines on our **Community of Practice** regardless of where one currently stands in our Growth Framework. We are focused on delivering a **WOW**! experience whilst ensuring a **resilient**, **error-free** and **scalable** codebase.

As a Staff Mobile Engineer you'll be:

* You will be learning and sharing knowledge with our engineers on new things often, as we believe in experimentation, T-shaped engineering and collaborative learning for career growth.
* You will be working on defining vision and strategies on how we build products for our Business Areas. We have an exciting roadmap with brand new features and we will need you to solve interesting problems.
* Act as a supportive and enthusiastic technical lead, by advocating for best practices on how we deliver the best software for our members based on data while contributing to the wellbeing of the team.
* Joining one of our expanding multi-disciplinary agile teams, you will work together with product owners, UI/UX designers, architects, engineers, and other business members to translate requirements into well-engineered solutions.
* You will join our **Flutter Community of Practices**, and your input on how to improve processes and maintain high quality across the team will be very welcome.
* Career progression is as important to us as it is for you, and we, therefore, have put in place a Tide Growth Framework to guide you. With our expanding teams and business, we will encourage you to outgrow your initial responsibilities, if you so desire.

Our company is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment, that fosters cooperation in everything we do. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to make a real difference with responsibilities across engineering practices in a supportive and rapidly expanding company!

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* You have several years of experience as a Software Engineer working with Flutter, native mobile (iOS or Android), or React Native.
* You have experience with popular Flutter libraries, tools and its lifecycle.
* You are passionate about building great products in small, autonomous, agile teams.
* You have a passion for automation tests and experience writing testable code.
* You have experience building sleek, high-performance user interfaces and complex Mobile apps that successfully shipped to customers.
* Experience technically leading Mobile engineers within cross-platform teams, with the ability to develop and mentor less-experienced developers.
* Experience leveraging automation and tooling, focused on Continuous Integration, Delivery and Deployment.

**OUR TECH STACK**

* We utilise the latest iterations of **Flutter** and **Dart**.
* We use popular and trusted plugins, packages, and tools, preferring leveraging existing solutions over reinventing the wheel.
* We adopt a modular approach in building our applications, viewing each small package akin to a Lego block. More on our approach can be found here.
* With **Melos**, we handle an extensive Dart codebase, featuring over 300 packages and around 2 million lines of code.
* We manage state and dependency injection efficiently using **flutter\_bloc**, **get\_it** and **injectable**.
* Our application navigation leverages **auto\_route** and **flow\_builder**.
* We approach the backend communication implementation using **freezed**, **json\_serializable**, **retrofit**, and **dio** interceptors. More about this approach here.
* We heavily rely on code generation with **mason** and **build\_runner**.
* **i69n** is our tool of choice for localisation. You can find how we do it here.
* We're deeply committed to Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) tests, and we use **bdd\_widget\_test** to help us on that. You can find more here.
* **Firebase Suite**, **DataDog**, **LaunchDarkly**, and **Segment** assist us in tracking, monitoring, and deploying securely.
* Our CI/CD pipelines and weekly releases are facilitated by **GitHub** and **GitHub actions.**

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* **Competitive Compensation -** competitive salary and share options
* **Time Off –** Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* **Parental Leave –** Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* **Sabbatical –** Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* **Health Insurance –** Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* **Life & Accident Cover –** Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* **Mental Wellbeing –** Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* **Volunteering & Development Days –** Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* **Learning & Development –** Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* **WOO (Work Outside the Office) –** Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* **Home Office Setup –** Contribution towards setting up your home office
* **Laptop Ownership –** Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
* **Snacks & Meals –** Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone's voice is heard.

  

*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone's voice is heard.*

**Disclaimer**

*It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:*

* *Tide does* ***not*** *charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.*
* *All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our* ***Careers Page*** *and applications should be submitted through this channel.*
* *Communication from Tide will only come from an official* ***@tide******.co*** *email address.*
* *Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.*

*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at* *talent@tide.co*  
*Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*

  

*Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our* *AI Policy**.*

*Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* *Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

title: Head of Growth, Brand & Product Marketing - Mobile Dating App
description:
**About Us**

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

**Job Description**

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Shape the product:** Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
* **Improve the user experience:** Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
* **Build the brand:** Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
* **Own go-to-market:** Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
* **Create marketing content:** Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
* **Build content pipelines:** Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
* **Develop influencer marketing:** Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
* **Establish partnerships:** Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
* **Drive measurable growth:** Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
* **Automate operations:** Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
* **Support future team growth:** As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
* Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
* Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
* Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
* Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
* The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
* Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
* Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
* A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
* The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
* A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
* Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
* Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

  

* Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
* Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
* Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
* Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
* Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
* Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
* Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
* Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

**What We Offer**

  

* A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
* Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
* The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
* The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

**How to Apply**

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

* Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
* Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
* Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
* AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
* Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

title: Project Coordinator Executive
description:
**Project Coordinator Executive Role**

Location: Dwarka, New Delhi (On-site)

Experience Required: 1-3 years

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and tech-savvy **Project Coordinator Executive** who can independently manage client communication, coordinate multiple projects, track deliverables, and ensure timely execution across internal teams. The ideal candidate has knowledge in website development, software solutions, digital marketing, creative services, or AI-powered projects.

\*This is a **non-coding**, client-facing role requiring familiarity with technical workflows, effective communication, and ownership of delivery. The candidate must use AI tools, LLMs, project management platforms, and automation solutions to improve productivity and coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

End-to-End Project Coordination

* Coordinate projects from client onboarding and requirement gathering to final delivery.
* Plan and monitor timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies.
* Coordinate with developers, UI/UX designers, graphic designers, video editors, digital marketers, and QA teams.
* Allocate and monitor tasks using Jira, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, or similar tools.
* Conduct follow-ups, identify delays and risks, and escalate critical issues with proposed solutions.
* Ensure delivery within agreed timelines, scope, and quality standards.

2. Client Account Management & Communication

* Serve as primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Conduct client meetings, gather requirements, and manage expectations.
* Share regular project updates, progress reports, and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate approvals, revisions, feedback, and deliverables across teams.
* Resolve client queries and escalations professionally and maintain client satisfaction.
* Identify potential renewals, account expansion, and additional service opportunities.

3. AI-Powered Project Management & Workflow Automation

* Use ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and similar LLM tools to support day-to-day coordination.
* Draft meeting summaries, action points, client updates, and follow-up communications using AI.
* Convert client requirements into structured task lists, briefs, and execution plans.
* Explore Zapier, Make, n8n, and AI-enabled productivity features for recurring-work automation.
* Validate AI outputs before sharing and protect confidential client and company data.

4. Requirement Gathering & Documentation

* Translate client needs into actionable project briefs and task sheets.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, timelines, trackers, and progress reports.
* Coordinate wireframes, workflows, and user journeys with UI/UX teams.
* Document meetings, decisions, feedback, revisions, and approvals.

* Coordinate SEO, performance marketing, social media, influencer marketing, branding, and video-production work.
* Understand service delivery workflows sufficiently to liaise with specialist technical and creative teams.

* Maintain daily and weekly task and delivery trackers.
* Monitor deadlines, ownership, progress, and team dependencies.
* Coordinate internal quality checks and reviews before client submissions.
* Track client feedback, revisions, outstanding actions, and completed deliverables.
* Provide concise weekly project status and risk reports to management.

* Work with Agile approaches including Scrum and Kanban.
* Support sprint planning, prioritization, stand-ups, and progress reviews as needed.
* Coordinate handovers among development, design, QA, marketing, and creative teams.
* Support resource planning and workflow improvements to increase efficiency.

8. Account Growth & Client Retention

* Maintain relationships with existing clients and monitor satisfaction.
* Proactively resolve service-related issues and anticipate future requirements.
* Spot cross-selling, upselling, renewals, and repeat-business opportunities.
* Coordinate with business development teams on account growth.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc. IT, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, client servicing, account management, or IT/digital agency operations.
* Experience coordinating web development, software, creative, digital marketing, or technology projects.
* Hands-on professional use of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or similar LLM platforms.
* Familiarity with AI-powered automation, documentation, content workflows, or project-management processes.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or comparable project-management platforms.
* Understanding of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, and Kanban; ability to prepare BRDs, FRDs, task trackers, and status reports.
* Basic understanding of websites, UI/UX, digital marketing, and AI-powered business services.
* Excellent spoken and written English, client handling, stakeholder management, and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace; ability to coordinate multiple clients and deadlines.
* Strong organization, problem-solving, multitasking, and accountability in a fast-paced AI-first startup.

Job Types: Full-time, Fresher, Internship

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
description:
**Location:** 100% Remote  
**Employment:** Full-time, long-term position  
**Start date:** As soon as possible after selection and agreement  
**Salary:** Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

**About Us**

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
* Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
* Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
* Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
* Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
* Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
* Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
* Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
* Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
* Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
* Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
* A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
* The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
* Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
* The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
* BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
* UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
* NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
* Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
* Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
* The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
* Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

**Remote Working Arrangement**

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

* Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
* Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
* The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
* Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
* Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
* Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
* Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
* Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
* Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
* Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
* Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
* Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
* Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
* Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
* Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
* Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
* Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
* Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
* Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
* Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
* A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
* The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
* Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
* The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
* Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
* BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
* UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
* NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
* Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
* Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
* Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
* Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
* The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
* Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

**Remote Working Arrangement**

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

* Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
* Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
* Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
* The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
* Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
* Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

title: QA Engineer (Mobile & Web)
description:
Ryan\-Miranda Partners is a small US\-based software firm.

We build and operate consumer mobile and web applications used by hundreds of thousands of people across iOS, Android, and the browser.

You would join our established India\-based engineering team and report to our lead engineer in Delhi. We work async: a short written plan in the morning, a short written summary in the evening, and very few meetings.

**About the role**

You are the last check before a release reaches users. Our senior developers build the features; your job is to take what they built, run it on every platform, and confirm it works before anyone else sees it. Eventually this role can get promotion.

To be upfront: this is not a feature\-development seat. It is closer to an SDET or release engineer than a manual testing role.

You will read Swift and TypeScript every day, drive three toolchains, and your verification is what lets the rest of the team ship quickly. What you will do

\- Reproduce bugs on real devices, confirm the fix, and check the screens around it

\- Check out branches and run our codebases on three platforms: iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android (React Native), and web (TypeScript/React)

\- First\-pass verification of pull requests: run the change on\-device, confirm it does what the ticket says, and write up what you found

\- Manual and regression testing on TestFlight and Google Play internal builds ahead of each release

\- Write clear reproduction steps and test cases in Jira

\- Post a short written plan each morning and a written summary each evening, like the rest of the team

\- Over time, build the automation that replaces your own manual passes: Maestro flows, snapshot suites, and CI checks

Pay: ₹65,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
